input.quote: 4.3 Ownership of the Wet Segment shall be as shown in Schedule B to this Agreement. The Wet Segment of APCN 2 shall be owned by the Parties in common and undivided shares.
input.rationale: This is a submarine cable construction and maintenance consortium agreement, not a services/deliverables contract, and it contains no intellectual property, work-product or Customer Data clause anywhere (searches for "intellectual property", "work product", "deliverable", "copyright", "patent" and "licence/license" return nothing). The only ownership provisions are asset ownership and they run in our favour: Terminal Parties own and provide their Segments (p0107), Wet Segment ownership follows our investment share in Schedule B (p0119), and we obtain Allocated Capacity on an ownership basis in return for our financial investment (p0187) — i.e. we own what we pay for. An IRU expressly "does not convey ownership" (p0054), so nothing conveys or assigns our property or data to the counterparties, and no counterparty receives any licence over our data: Paragraph 31 instead binds every Party to hold all data and information acquired in connection with APCN 2 confidential (p0270), with only regulatory/court and operational-necessity exceptions. Nothing triggers the walk-away: there is no assignment of our IP or data and no joint IP ownership. Noted only in passing (not a deviation): the undivided common ownership of the Wet Segment in p0119 is joint ownership of a physical asset that is the core consortium bargain, and it is coupled with our own capacity rights and resale/IRU rights under Paragraph 12, so it is not joint IP ownership without an unrestricted right to exploit. Because there are no Deliverables, Vendor IP or Customer Data constructs in this bargain, the direction the rule guards against is absent and no redline is warranted.
